audit.done_by: independent Claude adjudicator (sales_engineer subagent, no paid model), 19 Oct 2026, ruling on the extra trades of the first three runs; recorded by sales_engineer after the release operator's decision on #1483
audit.method: each proposed code outside the blind truth was ruled LINE_OF_BUSINESS, PASSING or NOT_OFFERED against the trade definition, reading the file
audit.note: The blind trades and trades_also above are UNCHANGED. verified_in_file is an allowance the scorer's audited score reads; the strict score stays the blind truth.
audit.premise_m07: The request to the adjudicator stated that a trade-licence activity the company presents as its own is a line of business. M07 electrical, gypsum, hvac and plumbing rest on that premise; without it they would be PASSING at most.
audit.caveat_m12: M12 building_materials and hvac are lines of the group's member companies; they count only because the document is the group's own brochure (rule 4).

M06:lighting_fixtures.why: A division of its own that designs, supplies and installs floodlights, streetlights, downlights, track lights and LED decorative luminaires. That is indoor, outdoor and decorative lighting.

M07:electrical.why: 'Electrical Fitting Contracting' is a licensed activity in the company's own trade licence, included in its profile. The profile also lists MEP Works and electrical cable networks.

M07:gypsum.why: 'False Ceiling & Light Partitions Installation' is a licensed activity in its own trade licence, included in its profile. False ceilings and partitions are in the definition.

M07:heavy_equipment.relied_on: Cover; Main Activities '1. Earth works.' (p5); 'fleet of heavy' equipment (p12)
M07:heavy_equipment.why: Earth works is its first main activity, carried out with its own heavy fleet. Excavation and earthmoving are in the definition.

M07:hvac.why: It is a licensed activity in its own trade licence, included in its profile. Installing and maintaining AC and ventilation is the definition.

M07:plumbing.why: 'Plumbing & Sanitary Installation' is a licensed activity in its own trade licence, included in its profile. The profile also has sewerage, drainage and potable-water network work.

M12:building_materials.relied_on: OCR l.46-47 (SPEED HOUSE TRADING CO. LLC: 'General Trading & building Materia[ls]')
M12:building_materials.why: This is a group profile, and the group presents its trading arm as a building-materials trader. Caveat: if the profile is judged as a single legal entity rather than the group, this is a sister company and would be NOT_OFFERED.

M12:hvac.relied_on: OCR l.61-63 (SPEED HOUSE CONTRACTING CO. LLC: 'HVAC, Civil Works')
M12:hvac.why: The group's contracting company presents HVAC as one of its two stated lines. The same group-versus-sister-company caveat as the building_materials item applies.

M09:cables_wires.why: It makes cable management systems: trays, ladders, trunking, floor boxes and strut. These are containment, which sits under electrical ('Cable trays & containment'). It does not make power or control cables, wire rope or cable accessories.

M06:engineering_consultancy.why: A department of its own presents civil, structural and electromechanical design. Structural and MEP design are in the definition.

M10:thermal_insulation.why: 'Thermal Insulation Blocks' are concrete masonry blocks it makes, so they belong under building_materials (blocks and bricks). It offers no roof, wall, facade, acoustic or pipe insulation work.
